title: Quentin and the Salt
author: Tamsin Nakamura
blurb: Coral Voss, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
